description: This file defines types, functions, and logic for managing and reporting the status of hooks within the OpenClaw project, including building hook status entries and generating a workspace hook status report.

methods.name: resolveHookKey
methods.description: Resolves the hook key from a HookEntry, using metadata or hook name.

methods.name: normalizeInstallOptions
methods.description: Normalizes the install options for a hook entry, assigning default labels based on kind.

methods.name: buildHookStatus
methods.description: Builds a HookStatusEntry object from a HookEntry, evaluating requirements and configuration.

methods.name: buildWorkspaceHookStatus
methods.description: Generates a report of hook statuses for a workspace, optionally using provided entries and configuration.
